page.title: Three questions before the requirements are written
page.lede: Your answers decide the requirements. Pick an option or write your own; nothing is chosen for you.

questions.title: Who can file a report?
questions.context: This sets how much sign-in the app needs.

options.why: Hikers on a trail want to report in seconds. A nickname is enough for conditions.

options.text: Anyone, but reports from accounts count more

questions.title: Which kinds of report are in the first version?
questions.context: Choose every kind that should be there.

options.text: Trail condition (clear, wet, muddy, snow, blocked)
options.why: It is the one thing every hiker wants to know.

questions.title: Is there anything the app must never do?
questions.context: Anything you would turn the app off for.

answer.prompt: When you are done, press Done and say "form is done" in chat.
